balls.text: he angles this in, and goes full just outside off. Lomror looks to have a hoick, but is beaten

Dhoni takes it halfway towards where a square leg would have been! A cutter from Thakur, although on a length just outside off. Maxwell had a massive swipe, but sent the ball up into the (rainy) clouds. Dhoni kept his eyes on it while moving to his left
between extra cover and cover-point! Full toss around fifth stump, and he opens the face of the bat to slice it in the gap for four. The ball raced away to the fence there
half a helicopter shot from Maxwell! Thakur goes for the yorker but instead delivers a low full toss on fifth stump, which Maxwell deposits over long-on
Rahane at deep midwicket moves quickly to his left, but can't prevent the second run. A yorker-length ball on the stumps, and Maxwell gets his front leg out of the way to hoick at it
ahh, a mistimed shot from Green! Gets a low, dipping full toss around off, and goes lofting, but the ball goes aerially towards long-on

reverse swatted incredibly over Dhoni's head, to also beat both short third and short fine! The ball is on the shorter side of a length, but Maxwell has decided already that he's going to go ahead with the reverse swing (of the bat)

this is edged behind, though! Hardly any reaction from Dhoni this time. Deshpande went fullish, and pretty wide of off. Karthik looked to loft, but got an outside edge, which settled into Dhoni's gloves
ohh, almost a double chance there for CSK! Karthik reverse scoops at this length ball which is very wide of off, and Dhoni moves to his right, while short third goes to his left - but all in vain!
a golf swing for six! He gets slightly across a bit late, and has a heave across the line at this length ball outside off. Six over midwicket
short of a length, and around ninth stump. Karthik lets it go
this is a low full toss yet again, as Green rams it back. The ball deflects off Deshpande's legs to go to long-on

ohh, this seems like a tough call! It is called wide, and Gaikwad reviews. On a length and with a scrambled seam around sixth stump, as Green went lofting but missed. There was some extra bounce there too. The third umpire checks if Green got across, but he didn't. But, but... the length is still deemed to be wide enough. Dhoni not impressed with the call. Tries explaining to the umpire that Green had moved his right. Shakes his head after that
well bowled! It is a yorker around sixth stump, and Karthik drags it to deep point
another low full toss on middle and off, and this is swiped to midwicket
good work by Jadeja moving to his left from deep third, as he slides and keeps the ball back just about. Karthik opened the face of the bat to slice this near yorker-length ball outside off

more boundary heroics from Mitchell! He is placed at a straightish long-on, to the left of where he would ideally have been. He takes it reverse cupped, and realising that he was on the edge of the rope, threw the ball back in the air on the field of play while taking a step behind. He comes back, though, and completes the catch. It was another low full toss from Thakur outside off, and Patidar went slapping down the ground, but barely missed out
nicely bowled! This is a low full toss - almost a yorker - on off, and is pushed to long-on, as the bat turns in his hands
and even the new ball lands over midwicket! Thakur now goes on a length outside off, and Green swivels to hammer that over the shorter boundary again
bam! Six over deep midwicket! A full toss from Thakur dipping on off stump, and Green hoicks across the line to capitalise with the maximum
over deep square leg! Patidar starts and ends the over with a six. Gets a length ball around sixth stump, and just slightly gets across to swing liberally with the full flow of the bat
full and wide, around eighth stump. Patidar still goes slashing, but misses

ahh, he is hit on the helmet! Short of a length from Deshpande, and around off stump. It climbs up towards middle to cramp Patidar for room. He went hooking, but was hit on the back of his head. The mandatory concussion check is quickly wrapped up
wide given. Short and wide of off, as Patidar let it go, with the ball rising rather sharply
ahh, beaten by the change of pace. On a length from Deshpande, and outside off. Patidar went swiping early, and missed while again losing his bottom hand
lowish full toss, and wide of off. Drilled to long-off
on the bounce to long-off. He throws his hands at this low full toss outside off, and loses his bottom hand. The ball went lofting towards the fielder
wow, this is just six! But it was the shot which stood out. Shorter side of a length around sixth stump, and Patidar almost flat-batted a pull over long-on

dropped by Gaikwad! And to further the pain on Thakur and CSK, the ball trickles away to tickle the rope at long-off. Thakur bowled on a fullish length outside off, and Green clubbed the ball back down the ground to hit hard and flat. Gaikwad, while taking a few steps forward, dropped the ball while trying to grab it near his chest. He lost balance and fell, and the ball went rolling away behind him
a dipping, low full toss in the channel outside off. Patidar has a heave across the line, and the ball takes the inside half of the bat to go to deep square
drills this length ball wide of off to play wide of long-off
boom! Six over long-on! A low full toss around fifth stump, and Green went through the line to send the ball flaying away just over a jumping long-on fielder

a but of an appeal for lbw, but turned down. Thakur tries to convince Dhoni... but of course it will be Gaikwad who will review. Patidar got across the stumps, and stood around fifth stump. He went sweeping at this fullish ball just outside off, and was hit on the front pad as he missed. There is no inside edge, as confirmed by replays, and ball tracking shows the impact is outisde off

ahh, almost taken! But it was a difficult chance, as Patidar threw his bat at this yorker-length ball around sixth stump, and the ball took off from the outside edge. Simarjeet at fly slip had a leap, but the ball evaded his fingers
ahh, backs away, and Theekshana goes shorter and quicker. Green went to cut hard, but was beaten
right between both long-off and long-on running towards each other! Green launches this fullish ball on middle after clearing his front leg, as Theekshana is attacked this time
full and flat, and on the stumps. Pushes and finds cover
a low full toss on his pads, and whipped to fine leg from deep in the crease
this is much fuller, and slower on off. Driven to long-off
fullish length, and pretty quick just outside off. Green looks to stab, but is beaten
ahh, nice comeback! A yorker angled in, and landing on off, as Green presents a flat bat to guide the ball to deep third
swatted to deep point! The man on the boundary was at deep backward point, and Green got the width off a length outside off to bash it away in the vacant region
another one. Almost a repeat of the last ball, although the line is much wider, and the length is full. Green doesn't have to put bat on ball
goes fullish and wide outside off. Green lets it go, and it is called wide
punches at this length ball in the channel, and bags a single to deep point
flung away over fine leg! He has a swivel as he hoicks this length ball angled into him, and landing on his pads. The shot looked so cleanly hit
ohh, a lucky four! He went driving hard at this fullish ball in the channel, and the ball took the outside edge to fly between the keeper and short third
short of a length just outside off, and pulled to deep square leg

ohh, half an appeal for run-out at the non-striker's end! Santner bowled fullish and straight, as Patidar drove back. Santner stretched his right hand out and got a finger tip, but du Plessis, at the other end, put his bat inside the crease in time even as he seemed to backing out. However, in a late twist, his bat is deemed to be in the air when the bails came off. The third umpire, though, takes a look several times over before coming to a conclusion. But a superb over for CSK nevertheless
continues an over full of singles, as Santner bowls on a length, and outside leg, as du Plessis backs away. Hacked to deep point
short of a length on the stumps, and turned behind square. Dhoni gives the chase
very full, and on the stumps. This was quicker too, as du Plessis drills it to long-on
gives himself room, and Santner follows by going on a shortish length outside leg. Clipped to deep square
on a length on the stumps, and whipped towards deep midwicket
bowls this after hiding the ball, and goes short and wide-ish of off. Swatted to long-off
yorker ball on off, and jammed to long-on
fuller ball angled into off, and straightening away. Pushed behind point
hammered over long-off! Patidar gets a length ball around sixth stump, and he swings his arms freely as he has got the room to go after it
this is a dipping, low full toss on middle, and is clipped to deep midwicket. Fifty for du Plessis too!
on a length just outside off, with a hint of turn away. Swatted down the ground
now wide of long-off! Goes inside out after making room, even as the face of the bat seemed to have opened late. Full ball from Jadeja, and outside off, as du Plessis went thrashing again
bam, six into the sightscreen! Skips down, and gets to the pitch of the straightish ball to bash it down the ground
fullish and quick on his pads at 103kph. Clipped wide of long-on
turns away off a length, and is pushed to deep point
backs away, and drills through cover! Full and on the stumps, with a hint of turn away, as du Plessis rams fout to deep extra cover
short of a length on middle, and whipped to deep square
beauty! Drift, turn and bounce to beat Patidar's jab
sharp turn to beat Patidar outside off

Kohli's party is over and Mitchell takes it at long-on after having briefly lost balance because he was mindful of the ropes. Kohli went against the turn and ended up hitting it wider than he would've liked. Excellent innings.
cruuuuuunchy sound of ball on bat as Kohli pumps him over deep midwicket! Touch too full from Santner and Kohli brought out the slog sweep that he son wonderfully has lately.
turns it towards midwicket, MS Dhoni hares across the turf to pick up the ball
touch fuller on the stumps, Kohli deflects it to short third for a single
cuts it wide of cover
nails the slog sweep! Right into the slot, Kohli cleared his front leg and absolutely muscled that away. Lovely hit. Kohli belts out a roar as he completed the shot
beaten as he tries to delicately steer it past short third. Plenty of bite off the pitch for Jadeja
slaps it straight to cover as Jadeja bowls into the pitch
hit back hard to Jadeja who parries it to long-off
backs away and slaps this shortish delivery into the gap at sweeper cover, Rachin Ravindra nearly made a mess of that because he overran the ball
pushed to cover as Santner fires one into the stumps
sliced to deep point, opened the bat face to pick the gap
punched to long-off
fired in from around the stumps, Kohli taps back
stunning power from Kohli as he backs away and absolutely gives it everything to slap it over cover.
sharp turn, raging turn. Beats Kohli's outside edge as he jabs at that.
dabs it to short third for a single
punched to point, they scamper a run
tucks it into the gap at deep midwicket, aggressive running to complete the second. Raises RCB's fifty.
cuts to deep point
flays this past short third! Short on the stumps, Kohli backed away and went hard with the cut shot. The extra bounce meant the ball also flew off the edge.
mistimes this lofted hit to long-on. Backed away to go over cover, ended up dragging it
hit on the body as Kohli's way too early into the pull. Not easy. The pitch has wildly changed character post the rain break
mistimes this heave to deep midwicket
beaten again as the ball cuts back in ever-so-slowly, well after Faf swung through
mistimes a pull back to the bowler
drilled down town, clean strike to clear mid-off. That should get Faf going again after all the playing and missing.
beaten again as he tries to back away and pull. The ball grips and spins in sharply.
sharp turn, square turn. Kohli bails out of an attempted slap
backs away and pulls one bounce to deep midwicket
has a wild swing across the line, beaten. Once again sharp turn on offer for Santner. Foot is grounded, third umpire has a quick look at that and rules it not out.
makes room to slap this through cover, but is beaten by the slowness of the surface
grips the deck and bounces off a length outside leg, Kohli gets a leading edge, but it rolls to point and they get a single
backs away to go over cover, but is deceived in the air and off the pitch. Lucky the thick edge doesn't carry to short third
punched to deep midwicket
grip and turn again off a length on middle, Kohli swung through but missed. Wide called as it spun back in a long way. Some purchase for the spinners, two-paced too, perhaps.
tucked into the vacant midwicket region for a single
hint of turn and bounce, saw Faf back away and so he tried to hit the deck, this one gripped and veered in to beat Faf's swing
goes length into the stumps, defended back
chops this to cover point
flicked to deep midwicket for a single
curves away a little as Kohli advances and slices this low full toss to deep point
hit on the body as he's a touch early into the pull. Was right in his hitting arc this one. Any bat on that would've meant a boundary.
beaten as he nibbles at one that moves away a hint from length outside off

steps out and pulls him deep into the stands at deep square. Appeared as if he may have been cramped for room just a touch as he advanced, but manufactured immense bat speed and power to hit that into the second tier.
punched straight to cover

Kohli is into the game now with this no-look savage flick! Picks this short of length delivery on middle and leg over deep backward square. Incredible flick of the wrists. Hit the roof and bounced back into the field of play.
belted straight and into the sightscreen! Shardul errs a touch and it's right in Faf's hitting range/
crunched through extra cover, Santner at the ropes does extremely well to run around 20 yards to cut that off, but can't.
through with the pull even before the ball arrived, beaten. It was a cross-seam delivery into the pitch from Shardul
driven sweetly to sweeper cover
first boundary for Kohli and RCB as Kohli walks into the shot and opens the bat face late to punch this to the left of backward point
lofted over the infield but there's sweeper cover to cut off the boundary
excellent delivery. Sees Faf charging down and shortens his length, tapped gently into the off side for a single
beaten as he sashays down the pitch to whack him over mid-off. Lovely shape for Deshpande
driven straight to cover as Deshpande bowls a tight line
shapes away from Faf as Deshpande bowls full on off again, defended to backward point
goes full on the stumps, swerves away slightly, Faf tucks it to short midwicket
short of length and moving away from outside off, steered to square third man

another dot... RCB make the playoffs! Short of a length, and again around sixth stump, as Jadeja went pulling but missed. So defending champs CSK are eliminated. The RCB players are leaping and rejoicing even before the ball has reached the keeper's gloves
ahh, and Jadeja is beaten! Again Chinnaswamy believe that RCB are all but through. On a length and wide-ish of off, as Jadeja swings but misses
full length on off, and he has a massive across-the-line heave. But there is an outside edge towards short third instead
ahh, and he is beaten! Short of a length and angling away at just 106kph, as Thakur has a pull but misses

slower ball... and Dhoni falls! Half the Chinnaswamy erupts out of joy; the other half wonders if they have seen Dhoni for the last time ever. Dayan bowls a length ball angling away towards off, but this is from the back of the hand. Dhoni goes hoicking across the line, but can hit it only as far as deep backward square leg. Who knows we may have seen the last of Dhoni on the field

pings the top tier! Dhoni goes for the pull, and although it seemed to have come off the top half of the bat, it went behind the wicket for a massive six. Dhoni swivelled at this shortish ball, and bang!

and Jadeja dumps it over midwicket! Gets his front leg out of the way of this length delivery which is angling across towards middle, and clobbers the pull for a timely - in every sense of the word - six!
short of a length on middle, and he pulls but gets a bottom edge towards deep square leg
bashed over extra cover! He went thrashing at this length ball outside off at 145kph, even as the ball came off the outside half of the bat
shorter side of a length on middle, and whipped to deep square
swat-pulls this shortish ball on middle and leg to hit past short fine. The ball dribbles away to the boundary. He just uses the pace of Ferguson there to time it in the gap
on a length around off, but seemingly too quick. A mistimed pull towards midwicket
it's an above-waist no-ball, and so a free hit. Ferguson bowls a beamer which is way over Dhoni, and dipping in front of Karthik. Dhoni looked to ramp still, but missed
shorter side of a length just outside off, and punched to point
ohh, this takes off rapidly off a short of a length on middle. Dhoni half-swivels to shape for a pull, but lets it go. Karthik has to jump full stretch to take that. Wide given
another short-of-a-length ball outside off, and swatted towards long-on
ramps over backward point! Siraj bowls short of a length, and slightly wide of off, as Jadeja reaches out and swats this to the boundary
ahh, bowls a length ball angling across towards sixth stump. Jadeja chops it back towards the keeper

bowls a bouncer around fifth stump, as Jadeja pulls towards square leg. Ah, there is a casual throw towards the non-striker, with the ball rolling away. So CSK pinch a second, which Kohli, obviously, doesn't like, and takes up with the umpire!
bang! Just over the fielder placed at a straightish long-off! On a length, and angling across towards off, as Jadeja presents the full face of the bat to launch it down the ground
change of pace again, and this is short and wide-ish of off. Slapped to deep point
slower ball, and on a length on middle and off. Guided towards short third
clipped off his pads! A low full toss arriving on middle and leg, and Dhoni plays it late to place it between the keeper and short fine leg
a lowish full toss on off, and flicked to long-on
good comeback! Bowls a near yorker-length ball on sixth stump, as Jadeja goes driving but is beaten

flashed over long-off! He opens the face of the bat a bit, and goes over mid-off, who is inside the circle. The ball is a slower one from the back of the hand and on a full length outside off, as Jadeja went through the line
swung to beat short fine leg! Short of a length from Green, and again coming back into Dhoni, who swivels to pull past the fielder
short of a length on middle, and pulled off the top half of the bat behind square
clips this length ball shaping in for a single to fine leg
swivels at this shortish ball angling into his pads, and whips to fine leg to pick two
fuller side of a length around fifth stump, and shaping in. Nudged back to the bowler
fullish ball on middle, and pushed to long-on

wow, superb catch by du Plessis! Santner is left shocked, even as the RCB supporters are jumping with joy. Placed at mid-off, du Plessis flies a few above, and stretches his right hand across. It would make for a fantastic pic if someone might have captured it: the ball in du Plessis' hands, and du Plessis defying physics. Siraj bowled a low full toss on off, and Santner lofted, only for du Plessis to intervene
skips down, and slaps this short-of-a-length ball around off to deep point on the bounce
ohh, the ball zips off the surface! It is called first bouncer, as Siraj bangs it on a hard length while angling it across. It ends over off stump, as Jadeja is surprised by the bounce
almost a yorker-length ball on fifth stump. Jammed to long-on
short of a length on middle and off, and swat-pulled to deep midwicket
on a length just outside off, and pushed to point, where there is a fumble
driven wide of mid-off! Green went on a fullish length, and angled that across. The ball finished around off, and Jadeja timed the drive well
fuller side of a length, and angling away towards off. Punched to deep point
length ball outside leg. He looked to clip, but it was quite wide

Dube's struggle ends! He falls for 7 off 15 balls, which is so many when you consider what is at stake. Green banged it on a back of a length at a change of pace, and got it to angle across towards middle and off. Dube, despite being as tall as he is, couldn't get the pull away. He found long-on instead, and had to depart
length ball angling across, and taking his pad as he looked to clip. The ball dribbled towards point, even as Dube was almost at the striker's end by the time Jadeja started
uff, just short of Karthik! He dived to his left, but the ball brushed his glove and went away. Jadeja saw good bounce off a length on sixth stump, and went poking, getting an outside edge
short of a length banged outside off. Chopped towards cover

ahh, complete mix-up, and Ravindra is run-out! CSK could lose all the momentum with this wicket, not least because Dube is struggling. Ravindra called for two initially, and Dube responded. But just after turning back to attempted the second, Ravindra said no. By then, though, Dube was almost through at the non-striker's end. So Ravindra was out of his crease. This is what happened before: he got a length ball angling into his pads, which he whipped to deep square
backs away, and thumps this full ball on off towards long-off
goes swinging across the line, but gets an inside edge past the stumps
dropped by Siraj! He came running and tumbling forward from long-on, as Dube heaved at this full ball on off, but top-edged it
chips this length ball towards extra cover, as long-off comes rushing forward. Du Plessis from cover moved and slid to his left too
short of a length on leg, and Ravindra went to pull but his hit high on his body
ahh, Kohli is at short cover, and Dube finds him again, as he pushes at a shortish ball angling across towards the stumps
another dot ball to Dube, who is now on 4 off 10 balls. Short of a length at rapid pace on off, and punched to cover
angles this length ball in around middle and off. Punched to deep point
ramped over short third! Ravindra giving the treatment to his New Zealand team-mate. Short of a length on fifth stump, and Ravindra rides the bounce before upper-cutting it

six over deep midwicket! He got his front leg out of the way, and thumped this full toss arriving at stump height on middle and leg. The fielder leaped, but the ball went above his hands. Fifty for Ravindra too!

ohh, a head-high full toss, and four to beat short fine leg to his left! It is, naturally, called a no-ball. So it is a free hit. It landed just above his head, as Ravindra swivelled to pull and went off the top edge
short of a length on leg, and nudged behind to fine leg
shorter side of a length on the stumps, and clipped to deep midwicket
ahh, on a fullish length just outside off, and quicker. Dube wanted to stab, but missed
this is much fuller, and on off. Chipped towards long-off
on a length on middle, and whipped to deep square
ahh, this turns away off a length on middle, and hits Dube on the back pad as he is squared up and beaten while he looks to push
shot of a length around off, and pulled towards deep midwicket
slower and fuller on leg stump, worked to long-on.
cutter on a length, punched to deep cover
excellent from Lockie as he cramps Dube up while also beating him for pace with that bumper. Dube was looking to arch back and ramp it wide of the keeper
dug into the pitch again, Dube gets besides the line as he defends
uppish but just wide of Kohli at short cover. Seems like the plan is to dig it in and trouble Dube with bounce

the slower delivery has done the trick! Lockie bowls a leg-cutter on a length, Rahane sees width and looks to go over cover but ends up slicing it to Faf at the edge of the ring at cover. It was a steepler but he made it look very easy. You'd think Rahane has done his job. Over to Dube & co now.
works this low full toss to deep midwicket
flays this to sweeper cover for a single
turns it from outside off to deep square
tucks it to deep midwicket
cut hard into the sweeper cover region, good work by Lockie Ferguson
fires it wide outside off to try and deny Rachin, misses his mark
drifted it away from Rachin, who looks to drag it to the leg side but gets it off a thick inside edge back to the bowler
clean strike inside-out over extra cover, was hitting it with the spin so it was safe and sumptuous.
slaps this to long-off, hit well but Maxwell comes around quickly
works it down to long-on as he churns strike back to the left-hander
whips this to wide long-on, Rahane wanted the second, Rachin wasn't keen
slog-swept deep into the stands at midwicket. Too much flight, Rachin was down on one knee in a jiffy as he picked it with the spin.
shortish on middle, pulled to deep midwicket
work it from outside off to deep midwicket.
punched to long-off
turns it from outside off to long-on
sharp turn again off a length outside off, check-punched to point
eased into the off side, behind point for a single, with soft hands
the leading edge flies just over Swapnil's outstretched hands
steered down to square third
flicked to deep square leg
sat up nicely for Rahane to wallop that behind point. Too much width and Rahane waa ready. Momentum for CSK
slapped wide of a diving Faf at mid-on! Timed nicely.
punched to deep point
the late movement does Rachin in but he gets a genuine edge that flies wide of the keeper
looks to cut, but again doesn't get enough bat on it, rolls to point off the inside edge
works it to square leg
works it gently to midwicket
drifts in and skids through as Rachin looks to make room and go over cover, ends up getting an inside edge onto the pad
not all that short, Rahane mistimes a pull to deep midwicket
sharp turn back in off a length to cramp Rahane for room. hits him high on the body
picks this full toss on the pads to deep midwicket, Yash Dayal from deep square does well to run around and stop it with his boot.
dug in short, Rahane is looking to upper cut but misses. DK leaps high to try and stop it one-handed but can't.
cut hard but Green does well to half-stop at cover point, they'll get a single
driven straight to mid-off

just a hint of width and Rachin's quick hands and excellent maneuverability helps him pick the gap through point even though Siraj didn't err by much. Pinged the middle of the bat, raced away. Delightful timing
flicked straight to deep square
drops it gently into the off side as they scamper a single. Just defended and looked up to find Rachin off the blocks in a jiffy.
picked away over long leg! This was short down leg, sat up nicely for Rahane to lift it up and over.
dabs it gently to short third, looks for a single but is sent back
off the edge, one bounce to short third. Plenty of movement for Yash Dayal, excellent line

no timing whatsoever as Mitchell looks to clear his front leg and loft this over mid-off, ends up picking out Kohli who does wonderfully well to run first to his left and then backwards to complete the catch.
short of length on leg stump, moves away appreciably off the deck, Mitchell punches to mid-off. Rachin was outside his crease and had to put in a dive to get back
firm push through the line but straight to mid-off
punched straight to cover
driven through cover and point. Not entirely off the middle, the bat face turned in his hand as he made contact but got enough on it
driven to Kohli at mid-off as they scamper a quick single. DK had to dive full length to his right to stop that wayward throw from Kohli
full and swinging back into middle and leg, flicked neatly between midwicket and mid-on, Kohli moves to his left from mid-on to cut that off.
full and swinging away from off-stump, squeezed to square third
excellent short, picks the length early and rocks back to crash that cut through point.
goes back and across as he tucks this to midwicket for a single
shapes to play a full-blooded pull but ends up playing a short-arm jab in the end to deep square
sharp turn, takes the edge and rolls to short third. Rachin was squared up. Lovely from Maxwell.
tucks this gently to deep square as they jog the single
turn but from middle and leg, batter misses, keeper misses and CSK get five wides. Handy

he has picked out short fine! Absolute half-tracker from Maxwell, but there's a hint of grip on the deck, extra bounce as well but Gaikwad thinks there's a scoring opportunity, ends up hitting it straight to Yash Dayal.
